name: distortionz_trucking
changelog: v1.1.4 — Run-ending destruction check. ADDED: the active run now cancels automatically if either the trailer or the truck is destroyed (engine + body bottomed out / smoking shell). Checked via IsEntityDead in both the pre-hookup attach watcher and the post-hookup drop-off loop, so a wrecked rig kills the job whether it happens at the depot or mid-haul. Trailer is checked before the truck since the cargo is the whole job — if both go up in the same explosion, the player sees 'Trailer destroyed. Run cancelled.' (vs 'Truck destroyed. Run cancelled.'). Server-side cancelJob is triggered with the matching reason string, and the local EndJob() teardown handles blip removal + vehicle cleanup + UI reset. INTERNAL: added an `if activeJob and ...` guard to the existing abandonment check so a destruction cancel earlier in the same tick can't accidentally double-fire abandonment. v1.1.3 — Standardized README badge block to the new flat-square format with dynamic version pull from GitHub releases. v1.1.2 — Reverted ground-snap helper. v1.1.1 was overcorrecting — depot ped sank into the sidewalk because the GetGroundZFor_3dCoord probe was finding ground at a Z lower than the actual standing surface. Reverted to spawn at Config.Depot.coords.z exactly. v1.1.1 — (broken) ground snap. v1.1.0 — Protected ped state bag added.
